title: Remove dead fields: WhoIsNode.addresses and UserProfile.profile_pic_url
description:
What: Delete two unused struct fields from kith-tslocal/src/lib.rs that appear in no production code paths.

Algorithm:
1. Remove WhoIsNode.addresses (line ~91, type Vec<String>, #[serde(default)])
2. Remove UserProfile.profile_pic_url (line ~108, type Option<String>, #[serde(default)])
3. Search for any remaining references with grep; confirm none outside tests
4. cargo build succeeds with -D warnings

Defensive programming rules:
- Do not remove StatusResponse.backend_state (KITH-626.20) — it IS used in kithctl/src/main.rs and in pre-login state detection
- After deletion, run cargo test -p kith-tslocal to confirm test suite still passes
- If any test references the removed fields, update the test fixture to omit them

Agent team: single R+I+T agent (one crate, small change)

Tests:
- cargo test -p kith-tslocal passes with no changes to test logic
- cargo build --all-features -D warnings passes
